opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an established independent researcher based at a UK university or UK not‑for‑profit research organisation, holding a permanent or fixed‑term position, with teaching and admin duties that can be relieved. Co‑applicants must be based in the UK, hold a permanent or fixed‑term position, and be from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across the social sciences, humanities, engineering and natural sciences, supporting collaboration between the British Academy, Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK, at any career stage, with prior public‑engagement experience; previous award‑holders cannot reapply.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects in the humanities and social sciences, delivered in partnership with GLAM or performing‑arts organisations.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: Travel, accommodation and visa support for early‑career scholars to attend a three‑day interdisciplinary symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, are post‑doctoral, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, and are not permanently appointed.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to support independent research leading to a publishable output, funded at 80 % of salary costs under the FEC regime.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, working in the humanities or social sciences, wishing to develop new quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities or language skills.
opportunities.summary: Short‑term awards to build methodological or interdisciplinary skills, supporting career development and future larger grant applications.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences, with an established role, collaborating with overseas partners; co‑applicants must be overseas.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects on the theme of Mobilities, integrating SHAPE or STEM disciplines, funded at 80 % FEC.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, interested in policy‑relevant work, to be based at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships to develop skills, networks and policy‑relevant analysis in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants who need support to make a British Academy application within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to cover specific additional needs such as equipment for disabled researchers, caring costs, or support for application preparation.
